claim: *Three correspondence patterns.* Derive where implementation is the source of truth; generate where the model is the source of truth; otherwise maintain traceability and check the correspondences that are decidable.

topology.description: Three peer columns: upward derivation, downward generation, bidirectional decidable check.

bw_encoding: Grayscale publication candidate. Gray model tier contrasts with implementation/system tier; upward, downward and bidirectional relations retained.
redesign: Gray model tier contrasts with implementation/system tier; upward, downward and bidirectional relations retained.
alt: Three peer columns distinguish direction of authority. Derive points upward from implementation to model; generate points downward from model to implementation or configuration; trace and check links model and system in both directions. Only decidable correspondences are checked when neither side fully determines the other. Gray fills distinguish the source semantic roles; labels and line conventions retain their meanings.
